scope: First fresh native Chrome refusal for Page archive (MHTML) in real admin Settings, using an owned disposable headed profile and the existing receipt-verified side-panel harness.
source_basis: The existing isolated admin sign-in runner proves the real web-form and extension Settings Sign in path without injected sessions.
The current native harness owned profile and release receipt safeguards are reused. Its new headed option changes only Chrome launch mode; headless remains the default.
CUA documentation supports binding a macOS app by path and inspecting its accessibility tree/screenshot, but Chrome for Testing prompt visibility has not yet been observed in this profile.
acceptance: Before the request, real Settings shows admin@admin.com and a declared Page archive switch OFF; Chrome permissions.contains and getAll both show pageCapture absent.

The runner pauses at real admin Settings before the permission request. An independent UI operator uses CUA on the owned Chrome for Testing app to click the actual Page archive switch, record the native prompt and Deny action, then writes only the word denied to the displayed acknowledgement file to resume the runner.

After the acknowledgement, the runner requires the real Settings refusal alert, switch OFF, permissions.contains false, and getAll absence. Its terminal status is postconditions_verified_requires_operator_evidence, never a standalone pass. Root combines the independent CUA evidence with those postconditions to adjudicate the case. The runner never mocks permissions.request, seeds grant state, or calls a Chrome permission override.
safety: The browser profile is new and disposable; no primary Chrome profile or stored grant is touched. The runner reads only authorized test credentials at the real web login form and suppresses raw browser/auth errors. It records booleans and receipt metadata in test-results. No archive is created.
runtime_gate: Root must authorize one headed launch after fresh source peer review and resource admission. The UI operator must confirm the selected Chrome for Testing window belongs to the new owned profile before clicking Deny. If CUA cannot access that prompt or Chrome grants without prompting, leave the case UNVERIFIED and record the observed reason.
verification: Native Chrome denial: not launched under this lane
limitations: The plaintext acknowledgement is coordination only and proves no native UI observation by itself. Root must retain independent CUA screenshot or accessibility evidence of the native prompt and Deny action before marking this case passed; the runner verifies only subsequent Chrome permission state and visible product feedback.
This first run covers pageCapture denial only. tabCapture may differ and remains separately unverified until exercised.
Current CUA inventory showed Google Chrome but no running Chrome for Testing; binding to the newly launched owned window remains to be confirmed in the admitted run.
runtime_attempt_001: Real web and extension admin sign-in passed. Page archive was declared, unique, OFF, and absent from Chrome contains/getAll. The runner stopped before a permission request with permission_switch_not_hittable from its bespoke coordinate target; no native prompt or Deny was reached. This is a harness interaction gap, not evidence of a product defect.
next_action: Root admits a fresh headed run after source review. At PAUSED, the CUA operator identifies the owned Chrome window and uses native UI to click the actual Page archive switch and Deny. Root combines the independent UI evidence with the runner's postconditions; the ACK alone never establishes a pass.
